messages:
Priya K: Quick check-in on the postmortem action list from Friday. Need owners and dates so we can close before the next regional rehearsal.
Jonas M: I'm in. Can someone paste the consolidated actions?
Priya K: Pasting high-level items: 1) Multi-region routing play refinement (owner: Jonas, due 2026-04-08) 2) Snapshot integrity + restore timing audit (owner: Elaine, due 2026-04-06) 3) Restore runbook with explicit failback steps + approval gate (owner: Priya, due 2026-04-05) 4) Game-day automation hooks & preflight checks (owner: Platform Eng, due 2026-04-12) 5) Recurring monthly restore rehearsal schedule (owners: Jonas/ELA, recurring).
Elaine C: I'll own the snapshot audit. Plan: export retention + size + restore-time estimates into a spreadsheet, tag items >45m. ETA 2026-04-06.
Jonas M: For routing play: propose adding a non-disruptive BGP withdraw simulation and a traffic-shaping pre-check. I'll draft the orchestration steps and a comms checklist. Target 2026-04-08.
Priya K: For the runbook I'll add a mandatory manual approval gate before promoting warm-standby and an explicit failback checklist (DNS checks, route asserts, cache warm-up). ETA 2026-04-05.
ops-bot: reminder: please attach ownership to existing incident tickets.
Jonas M: One pattern we keep seeing: cache cold-start after failover spikes latency. We should include a cache-priming traffic replay in the playbook. I can add a small replay harness under /ops/dr/replay.
Elaine C: Good call. I'll make sure snapshot restore tests include post-restore cache-validation steps.
Priya K: infra-bot, can you schedule a rehearsal window and create a JIRA epic?
infra-bot: scheduled: "Resilience rehearsal - BGP & restore" on 2026-03-31 02:00 UTC. Created epic: RI-2901. Child tickets: RI-2902 (routing play), RI-2903 (runbook updates), RI-2904 (snapshot audit).
Jonas M: For the BGP simulation: prefer manual promotion to warm-standby for first two rehearsals. Add explicit rollback commands and who hits them.
Priya K: Agreed manual for now. Runbook will document exactly who is authorized and the confirmation phrasing.
Elaine C: Snapshot audit note: two clusters have different lifecycle policies; I'll propose aligning policies and adding a quarterly policy review.
Jonas M: SLI proposal: "restore wall-clock time" <= 45m 90p. We'll measure during rehearsals and add to the dashboard.
Priya K: Action recap for closure: - Jonas: routing play + BGP dry-run (2026-04-08) - Elaine: snapshot audit + restore times (2026-04-06) - Priya: runbook + approval gates + failback (2026-04-05) - Platform Eng: preflight automation (2026-04-12) - Schedule monthly restore rehearsals and add SLI tracking. Reconvene 2026-04-09 for closure sync. :calendar: 
Elaine C: ACK. I'll post the CSV with restore estimates when ready.
Jonas M: ACK. I'll post the draft play sequence and preflight checklist.
Priya K: Thanks everyone. Adding retro notes to RI-2901 now. :thumbsup:
